choice_contract: Binary next-token A/B soft-target cross-entropy on9B native LM-head; argmax same logits; exacttieA; not free generation
train_labels: Only TRAIN reference preference based on normalized complete candidate errors; all neutral pairs soft.5
training_controls: Same FULL/LOCAL tasks and candidate order/labels. AUDIO true scores; TEXT unavailable. No zero/mismatch train labels.
limitations: Repeated historical contextual1334 dev, not official14326dev or new heldout
Cached512D float16 native frames; dictionary toneless phones and polyphone/same-phone/orthography issues
NativeCTC contains recognizer prior, not calibrated acoustic confidence; LOCAL hides text context but evidence is whole-utterance CTC
Supervised CE plus local auxiliary encourages but does not prove evidence necessity; no fabricated counterfactual score flips
Generated train drafts are in-sample for initializer; fixed train-only labels, historical error-enriched distribution
Forced candidate decisions not open-vocabulary correction, no claim of raw waveform understanding
Zero/mismatch scores can beOOD; no dev checkpoint/threshold/weight search
Fused attention/norm kernels can round differently from historical fallback; UNADAPTED A/B controls rerun with the identical new backend, old ASR drafts unchanged.
Seed repeats share the same historical dev and frozen in-sample drafts; report every seed, not independent heldout replication or best-seed selection.
revision: Predeclared matched AUDIO/TEXT independent-seed repeat; no dev-based selection
preparation: Hash-identical v3 sealed data/token bank; only training RNG and shuffle seed differ; original B/text initializer, not v3 final
